name: How long does a typical custom shelving project take from design to installation?

mainEntity.name: How long does a typical custom shelving project take from design to installation?

acceptedAnswer.text: The timeline for a custom shelving project varies significantly based on its complexity, material selection, and integration within a larger renovation. A simple, standalone unit might take a few weeks, while an elaborate built-in system as part of a whole-home remodel could span several months. During the initial planning phase, we establish a transparent project timeline, factoring in design approvals, material procurement, fabrication, and installation, ensuring clear communication about what to expect at each stage of our managed process.
acceptedAnswer.description: Project duration for custom shelving varies based on complexity and integration with other renovations, but we provide a transparent timeline during initial planning.
